findings.summary: Draft selection relies only on headRefName matching ^ai-sdlc/. A fork PR can name its branch ai-sdlc/x, so mark-ready may flip an outside contributor's draft to ready. This exposure already existed in the AISDLC-896 no-CodeQL path; ready is not merged and the merge gate enforces a trusted source. Optionally skip cross-repo PRs.
